AUD.name: 现金利率目标
AUD.definition: From 2 Aug 1990 onwards: cash rate target; from 23 Jan 1990 to 1 Aug 1990: middle of the cash rate target range; from 7 Apr 1976 to 22 Jan 1990: interbank overnight cash rate.

CAD.name: 隔夜利率目标
CAD.definition: From 1 Jun 1994 onwards: Central Bank target, overnight rate; from 27 Jul 1960 to 31 May 1994: official bank rate.

CHF.name: 瑞士央行政策利率
CHF.definition: From 13 June 2019 onwards SNB Policy rate; From 1 Jan 2000 to 12 June 2019 mid-point of the SNB target range; from 1 Jan 1946 to 31 Dec 1999: discount rate.

CNY.name: 1 年期贷款市场报价利率 LPR
CNY.definition: From 20 Aug 2019 onwards: Loan Prime Rate  (1 year): from 1 Jan 1996 till 19 Aug 2019: Official lending rate (1 year).

GBP.name: 银行利率
GBP.definition: From 3 Aug 2006 onwards: official bank rate; from 6 May 1997 to 2 Aug 2006: repo rate; from 20 Aug 1981 to 5 May 1997: minimum Bank of England Band 1 dealing rate; from 16 Oct 1972 to 19 Aug 1981: minimum lending rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 15 Oct 1972: bank rate.

INR.name: 政策回购利率
INR.definition: From 3 Apr 2001 onwards: official repo overnight rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 2 Apr 2001: oank rate.

JPY.name: 无担保隔夜拆借利率目标
JPY.definition: From 24 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent; From 17 Jun 2026 to 23 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL

KRW.name: 韩国银行基准利率
KRW.definition: From 7 Mar 2008 onwards: Bank of Korea base rate; from 6 May 1999 to 6 Mar 2008: target overnight call rate(base rate).

NZD.name: 官方现金利率
NZD.definition: From 17 Mar 1999 onwards: Official market intervention representative rate, official cash rate; from Jan 1985 to 16 Mar 1999: overnight cash rate.

USD.name: 联邦基金目标区间中点
USD.definition: From 19 Dec 1985 onwards: mid-point of the Federal Reserve target rate; from 1 Jul 1954 to 18 Dec 1985: US Fed Funds effective rate.

EUR.name: 存款便利利率
EUR.definition: From 18 Sep 2024 onwards: official central bank steering rate is the deposit facility rate, fixed rate; from 15 Oct 2008 to 17 Sep 2024: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate; from 28 Jun 2000 to 14 Oct 2008: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, minimum bid rate; from 5 Jan 1999 to 27 Jun 2000: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate.

CNH.name: 人民币政策参考：1 年期 LPR
CNH.definition: From 20 Aug 2019 onwards: Loan Prime Rate  (1 year): from 1 Jan 1996 till 19 Aug 2019: Official lending rate (1 year).
CNH.note: 与在岸人民币共用政策参考，不是离岸存款利率。

SGD.name: 汇率政策框架
SGD.note: 新加坡以贸易加权汇率为政策工具，没有可直接对应的单一政策利率。

method: 利率为年率；最近变动从同一官方日度序列计算，100 个基点=1个百分点。BIS 数据通常每周发布，并非实时央行公告。
